ns2:course.label: Banking and Financial Regulation
ns2:course.description: Survey of the structure, functions, regulation, and risk management activities of banks and nonbank financial institutions; central banking and monetary policy effects on financial institutions. Credit is not given for FIN 536 if the student has received credit for FIN 561 Banking and Financial Regulation (32674, 40803, 45887, 51669). Prerequisite: FIN 520 or consent of instructor.
